name: idx_approval_checkpoints_status
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_checkpoints_status
        ON approval_checkpoints(status, updated_at)

name: idx_approval_postcommit_recovery
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_postcommit_recovery
      ON approval_postcommit_effects(status, created_at, approval_id, effect_kind)

name: approval_checkpoints
sql:
CREATE TABLE approval_checkpoints (
          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          approval_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          run_id TEXT,
          task_id TEXT,
          media_job_id TEXT,
          external_work_action_id TEXT,
          workflow_step_id TEXT,
          channel_id TEXT,
          tool_call_id TEXT,
          action_type TEXT NOT NULL,
          risk TEXT NOT NULL,
          title TEXT NOT NULL,
          description TEXT NOT NULL,
          status TEXT NOT NULL,
          side_effect_json TEXT NOT NULL,
          preview_artifact_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
          result_artifact_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
          runner_resume_handle_json TEXT,
          created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
          updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
          resolved_at TEXT,
          resumed_at TEXT,
          resume_failure_reason TEXT, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, resume_basis_json TEXT,
          FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES approval_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

name: approval_postcommit_effects
sql:
CREATE TABLE approval_postcommit_effects (
      approval_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      effect_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(effect_kind IN ('decision_event', 'owner', 'control_plane_event')),
      owner_kind TEXT CHECK(owner_kind IN ('run', 'workflow_step', 'media_job', 'external_work_action')),
      owner_id TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'completed', 'blocked', 'effect_unknown')),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      claim_token TEXT,
      claim_expires_at TEXT,
      attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      last_error_code TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(approval_id, effect_kind),
      FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES approval_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

name: approval_requests
sql:
CREATE TABLE "approval_requests" (
          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          run_id TEXT,
          task_id TEXT,
          media_job_id TEXT,
          external_work_action_id TEXT,
          workflow_step_id TEXT,
          channel_id TEXT,
          tool_call_id TEXT,
          action_type TEXT NOT NULL,
          risk TEXT NOT NULL,
          title TEXT NOT NULL,
          description TEXT NOT NULL,
          payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
          status TEXT NOT NULL,
          created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
          expires_at TEXT,
          resolved_at TEXT,
          resolved_by TEXT,
          decision_reason TEXT, available_decisions_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '["approve_once","deny"]', proposed_command_rule_json TEXT, decision_kind TEXT, decision_rule_id TEXT,
          CHECK (
            (run_id IS NOT NULL AND task_id IS NOT NULL AND media_job_id IS NULL AND external_work_action_id IS NULL AND workflow_step_id IS NULL)
            OR (run_id IS NULL AND task_id IS NULL AND media_job_id IS NOT NULL AND external_work_action_id IS NULL AND workflow_step_id IS NULL)
            OR (run_id IS NULL AND task_id IS NULL AND media_job_id IS NULL AND external_work_action_id IS NOT NULL AND workflow_step_id IS NULL)
            OR (run_id IS NULL AND task_id IS NULL AND media_job_id IS NULL AND external_work_action_id IS NULL AND workflow_step_id IS NOT NULL)
          ),
          FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES run_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
          FOREIGN KEY(media_job_id) REFERENCES media_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
          FOREIGN KEY(external_work_action_id) REFERENCES external_work_actions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
          FOREIGN KEY(workflow_step_id) REFERENCES channel_workflow_steps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

name: trg_channel_session_approval_admission

CREATE TRIGGER trg_channel_session_approval_admission BEFORE INSERT ON approval_requests WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ling_threads t
    WHERE t.channel_id IS NOT NULL AND (t.archived_at IS NOT NULL OR t.status = 'archived') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ling_threads scope WHERE scope.id = t.id
    AND (NEW.channel_id IS NULL OR scope.channel_id = NEW.channel_id)) AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_sessions run WHERE run.id = NEW.run_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ling_threads scope WHERE scope.id = t.id
    AND (run.channel_id IS NULL OR scope.channel_id = run.channel_id))
    AND (EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE session_lineage(id, workspace_id, channel_id) AS (
    SELECT seed.id, seed.workspace_id, seed.channel_id FROM ling_threads seed WHERE seed.id = run.thread_id
    UNION
    SELECT parent.id, parent.workspace_id, parent.channel_id FROM session_lineage lineage
      JOIN ling_threads child ON child.id = lineage.id
      JOIN ling_threads parent ON parent.id = child.parent_thread_id
        AND parent.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND parent.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
      WHERE child.surface_kind = 'topic'
    UNION
    SELECT source.id, source.workspace_id, source.channel_id FROM session_lineage lineage
      JOIN ling_threads execution ON execution.id = lineage.id
      JOIN channel_workflows workflow ON workflow.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND workflow.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
        AND (workflow.id = execution.workflow_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_workflow_steps step
          WHERE step.workflow_id = workflow.id AND step.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND step.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
            AND (step.id = execution.workflow_step_id OR step.task_id = execution.task_id)))
      LEFT JOIN ling_turns source_turn ON source_turn.id = json_extract(workflow.metadata_json, '$.sourceTurnId')
        AND source_turn.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND source_turn.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
      LEFT JOIN conversation_items source_item ON source_item.id = json_extract(workflow.metadata_json, '$.sourceMessageId')
        AND source_item.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND source_item.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
      JOIN ling_threads source ON source.id IN (source_turn.thread_id, source_item.thread_id)
        AND source.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND source.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
      WHERE execution.surface_kind NOT IN ('channel_root','channel_session','branch')
  ) SELECT 1 FROM session_lineage WHERE id = t.id) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM channel_workflow_steps run_step JOIN channel_workflows run_workflow ON run_workflow.id = run_step.workflow_id
    WHERE run_step.id = run.workflow_step_id AND run_step.channel_id = run_workflow.channel_id
      AND run_step.workspace_id = run_workflow.workspace_id
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ling_threads workflow_source
    LEFT JOIN ling_turns workflow_source_turn ON workflow_source_turn.id = json_extract(run_workflow.metadata_json, '$.sourceTurnId')
      AND workflow_source_turn.thread_id = workflow_source.id AND workflow_source_turn.workspace_id = run_workflow.workspace_id
      AND workflow_source_turn.channel_id = run_workflow.channel_id
    LEFT JOIN conversation_items workflow_source_item ON workflow_source_item.id = json_extract(run_workflow.metadata_json, '$.sourceMessageId')
      AND workflow_source_item.thread_id = workflow_source.id AND workflow_source_item.workspace_id = run_workflow.workspace_id
      AND workflow_source_item.channel_id = run_workflow.channel_id
    WHERE workflow_source.workspace_id = run_workflow.workspace_id AND workflow_source.channel_id = run_workflow.channel_id
      AND (workflow_source_turn.id IS NOT NULL OR workflow_source_item.id IS NOT NULL)
      AND EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE session_lineage(id, workspace_id, channel_id) AS (
    SELECT seed.id, seed.workspace_id, seed.channel_id FROM ling_threads seed WHERE seed.id = workflow_source.id
    UNION
    SELECT parent.id, parent.workspace_id, parent.channel_id FROM session_lineage lineage
      JOIN ling_threads child ON child.id = lineage.id
      JOIN ling_threads parent ON parent.id = child.parent_thread_id
        AND parent.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND parent.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
      WHERE child.surface_kind = 'topic'
    UNION
    SELECT source.id, source.workspace_id, source.channel_id FROM session_lineage lineage

      JOIN channel_workflows workflow ON workflow.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND workflow.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
        AND (workflow.id = execution.workflow_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_workflow_steps step
          WHERE step.workflow_id = workflow.id AND step.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND step.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
            AND (step.id = execution.workflow_step_id OR step.task_id = execution.task_id)))
      LEFT JOIN ling_turns source_turn ON source_turn.id = json_extract(workflow.metadata_json, '$.sourceTurnId')
        AND source_turn.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND source_turn.channel_id = lineage.channel_id
      LEFT JOIN conversation_items source_item ON source_item.id = json_extract(workflow.metadata_json, '$.sourceMessageId')

      JOIN ling_threads source ON source.id IN (source_turn.thread_id, source_item.thread_id)
        AND source.workspace_id = lineage.workspace_id AND source.channel_id = lineage.channel_id

  ) SELECT 1 FROM session_lineage WHERE id = t.id))))))
